params.prompt:
Create an exciting, fun, polished 5-second square social ad video using the provided plumbing 1APP ad creative as the exact starting frame and the provided 1APP logo as the brand reference. Preserve the original ad layout, real 1APP logo, colors, phone UI, worker, vehicle, headline, subtext, CTA button, and all existing text exactly as shown. All text must remain crisp, readable, and stable for the entire video.

Fun motion direction: upbeat lead-alert energy. Add subtle pulsing glow around the phone call UI, quick soft sparkle/highlight sweeps, gentle parallax between the plumber, van, and floating UI card, and a clean push-in. Keep the text panels locked and sharp. Do not invent or change text. Do not add new words, fake letters, extra buttons, warped logos, strange hands, extra fingers, distorted tools, or mutated UI. No cuts, no scene changes, no audio.
